bio: Steeped in history, Gut Panker is a truly idyllic spot. The tranquil estate is the epitome of rural charm and is also known as a Trakehner stud farm – it forms the perfect backdrop for Hotel & Restaurant Ole Liese. Here, two establishments – Wirtschaft and Restaurant 1797 have been merged to create a new concept. In the evening, there is a choice of three set menus: Liese's Garten (vegetarian), Ole's Landhaus and Gourmet Menü 1797. Individual courses of each can be ordered à la carte. The cooking is regional, seasonal, and international, featuring dishes from caramelised goat's cheese to Königsberger Klopse (meatballs in a white wine sauce with capers) and barbecued octopus.
